widgets_values: A clump of tall wild meadow grass with thin seed-head stalks and a few dry blades, about one metre tall, growing straight up from a small patch of soil at the bottom edge, photographed straight on at eye level against a seamless plain light grey studio backdrop. Soft overcast daylight from the upper left, muted natural greens and straw colours, crisp detail on every blade, the whole clump in frame from the roots to the tips, nothing else in the scene.
